checks.description: All three CLIs (DWS, Jira, Todoist) are accessible and initialized
Both CSV source files exist with expected row counts
Per-supplier DWS reconciliation docs exist in the correct folder with source attribution
Reconciled values use correct source per field (weight from loading, amount from discharge, etc.)
Jira issues exist for overlapping suppliers documenting data conflicts
Priority, labels, and assignees are correct per rules
Follow-up tasks in Todoist with correct sections and priorities
Spot-check that each field used the correct source per resolution rules, including HS code strictness via tariff schedule
